propositions: Baseline description, status, and priority fields should be stored in normalized scalar form (ADF text string for description, Jira name string for status/priority) while assignee remains as raw vendor dict to preserve identity forms and enable concurrent edit suppression

Exact Jira name strings like 'High' and 'In Progress' must be stored in baselines instead of local-mapped values, because the live comparison path canonicalizes both baseline and remote sides identically through inbound_mapper.map_remote_to_local
Normalization via a projection helper must be idempotent, preserve field absence, and not alter summary or assignee, with no migration pass or comparator change required
The pre-A3 code must accept both scalar and vendor dict forms for backwards compatibility during rollback without lossy denormalization

A full-corpus measurement across 1,774+ baselines must verify zero mutation deltas in compute_update_fields verdicts under both forward current code and exported pre-A3 code, zero assignee value/shape deltas, and at least 50% serialized size reduction
